title: Native Weil derived tensor and internal Hom under forgetting Frobenius
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $T_0$ put $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$ and let $g_T$ be geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. On the small pro-etale site of $T$, let $R_T$ be the coefficient sheaf whose sections on a quasi-compact object $V$ are continuous functions $|V|\to\Omega$ with values in one finite intermediate extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$; on general objects impose this condition locally [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Write $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(R_T)$ for its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $\mathcal B_T$ for pairs $(F,\theta:g_T^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}F)$ in $\mathcal A_T$, with intertwining morphisms [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Derived categories mean localization of complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\mathcal W(T_0)\subset D(\mathcal B_T)$ be the full subcategory with bounded cohomology whose underlying cohomology sheaves admit a finite locally closed stratification with pro-etale locally finite free restrictions over $R_T$. This is the native category `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex`, not the category of fixed pairs in $D(\mathcal A_T)$.

Let $U_T:D(\mathcal B_T)\to D(\mathcal A_T)$ be induced by termwise forgetting $\theta$. The source has a symmetric closed derived tensor structure obtained from the tensor of module sheaves with diagonal Weil structure. Its internal Hom is the product total Hom complex of K-injective representatives used by `AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleWeilSheaf.derivedHom`, with the contragredient Weil structure, rather than derived global Hom. The functor $U_T$ is exact and conservative, commutes with cohomology, and restricts to a functor from $\mathcal W(T_0)$ to the bounded constructible full subcategory of $D(\mathcal A_T)$. For $K,L\in D(\mathcal B_T)$ the canonical natural comparisons
$$U_T(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}L)\xrightarrow{\sim}U_TK\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_T}U_TL,\qquad U_TR\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal B_T}(K,L)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_{R_T}(U_TK,U_TL)$$
are isomorphisms and preserve symmetry and evaluation. Explicitly the image under $U_T$ of $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal B_T}(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\to L$ is ordinary module evaluation under these comparisons. The tensor--Hom adjunction therefore gives, for every $W\in D(\mathcal B_T)$, a natural morphism $\delta^W_K:K\to R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal B_T}(R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal B_T}(K,W),W)$, defined as the transpose of evaluation after symmetry, and its image under $U_T$ is the analogous transpose for $U_TW$. No invertibility of $\delta^W_K$ is asserted.

proof.text: For the exact native forgetful functor use the existing mapDerivedCategory triangulated instance and cohomology natural isomorphism. A morphism whose image is invertible has every underlying cohomology map invertible. Ordinary forgetting reflects these isomorphisms, so DerivedCategory.isIso_iff proves derived conservativity. Exact derived forgetting preserves boundedness. Transport K.property.2 across the cohomology comparison to obtain constructibility.

Take the native two-injective model, and convert it to row-sign representative models using the row comparison lemma. Transport the tensor and its normalized adjunction onto those fixed models. Substitute the equal Hom models and comparison, keeping the representative compatibility proof.

Prove evaluation compatibility by uncurrying the specified Hom comparison and cancelling the tensor isomorphism. For bidual naturality, uncurry both sides, use symmetry naturality and contravariant evaluation naturality. For bidual compatibility, uncurry the iterated comparison, move the tensor isomorphism through symmetry, and cancel the Hom isomorphism with its inverse in the contravariant variable. Injectivity of the ordinary adjunction gives equality. These categorical arguments are explicit Lean proofs, using only the extracted closed-model definitions. Assemble these three facts with the supplied representative square and tensor coherence.
